description: Interrogate the cult member Hans to extract internal intelligence on the Alcanje organization; the investigators gradually uncover the enemy's structure and the true purpose of the Talisman.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: June 1st

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Meal

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: So everyone squeezed into the innermost booth of the restaurant, four burly men blocking the aisle like bookshelves.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Sighed inwardly, then continued eating

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: As you were dining, the table leg suddenly broke, causing the table to tilt. Soup bowls and documents slid to the floor. The four burly men reached out to steady the table edge, but the translation manuscript was already soaked in the spilled borscht. Other guests turned to look, and a waiter hurried over with a mop.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Look at the manuscript

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Step forward to help

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Look at the burly men, then look past them to see the surroundings

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player4 quickly pulled out the undamaged first half of the diary. The ink on the French pages was smudged but still legible.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #In Italian "Have you seen any Turks?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: So the translation is completely unsalvageable, soaked through.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "The translation is ruined. Could you ask your boss to send another copy?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player5 suddenly felt the muscle fibers of the chicken in their mouth writhing strangely, as if still breathing. Then, the knife cut into the chicken breast, and pale maggots boiled out. They dragged mucus over the plate rim, leaving shiny trails on the linen tablecloth.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Spit out the chicken

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: It seems no one around noticed this scene.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Look at the burly men "Did you do this?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... another Sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Hans frowned in confusion, "What do you mean?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Eh... another Sanity check? I understand, everyone's watching.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Huh!" #Check hand and knife again carefully

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player6 frantically shook their hand, throat squeezing out an incoherent scream.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Thought not" #Clapped hands lightly, lowered voice "Someone doesn't want us peaceful, we should give them some trouble too, knock something loose"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The waiter ran over in panic, "Do you need help, everyone?"

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Ouch ouch ouch" #Holding head

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: ( Can make a Spot Hidden check)

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Ask teammates to help look

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire. If it is what you wish for, it will surely be answered. <player5>'s Spot Hidden prayer:

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Look around

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire. If it is what you wish for, it will surely be answered. <player6>'s Spot Hidden prayer:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player5 noticed that although the three Turks at the neighboring table seemed to be chatting casually, their gaze remained fixed on the investigators' table. player6 saw a pale man in a black trench coat quickly lower his head to avoid eye contact, then turn and hurriedly walk into the kitchen passageway.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .ra侦查

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you expect, it will surely receive a response. <player4>'s investigation prayer:

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player4 is eating.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Devouring furiously

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "I'm fine for now, but I saw a suspicious person heading towards the kitchen passageway."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I'll go too, don't split up."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player6 and player4 rush into the kitchen passageway. The head chef waves a soup ladle and roars: Kitchen area, no unauthorized entry!

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Pat Hans, signaling him to follow Xiao Tang, then lead the others and the three burly men outside.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Where's that person? The one you saw."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: I did see a person in a black trench coat rush in here.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Come with me to the back."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Check if there are any other exits.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Look for the person in the black trench coat.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: You discover the kitchen is enclosed, with no way out.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: Excuse me, did you see anyone come in just now? That person is very important to us.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The chef slams the cleaver into the chopping board, not even a fly has flown in here!

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Beat a hasty retreat.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: #Since things have come to this, let's come out first.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The alley behind the restaurant is empty, only damp brick walls and scattered garbage bins.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Check for ventilation ducts and the structure of this damn building.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player5 looks up and sees a ventilation opening less than 30 centimeters square in the corner of the ceiling, its wire mesh caked with grease. The building is a typical Trieste row house; the restaurant occupies the ground floor of the arcade, and the shutters on the four floors of residential apartments above are all tightly closed.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Check if the Turks have followed out.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: No Turks have followed into the back alley; only the three burly men stand like statues waiting in the wind.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Qiduo received! Resuming recording for you—Cold Wind Howls—Trieste 1923. Currently recorded text: 2472 entries, time elapsed: 11 hours, 55 minutes, 35 seconds.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Last time, the story said:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Ask the burly men what time this restaurant closes.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Pick up a cup of tea and take a sip.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The burly man raises his hand to check his watch and says in a low voice that it's currently 2 PM; the restaurant usually closes at 10 PM.
